title: Ghar Deen Pe Shabbir Jo Karbal Mein Lutane Aye
body:
Bint-e-Zahra Teri Ghurbat Ke (x2) Zamanay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Woh Joh Kehte Te Muhammad Se Quran Hai Kafi (x2)
Rung Karbal Main Saqifa Ka (x2) Dekhanay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Boli Zainab Kesay Muslim Hain Yeh Dekho Baba (x2)
Khoon-e-alaad-e-payambar Ka (x2) Bahanay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Pani Peene Ke Liye Aye Na Hargis Asghar (x2)
Mein Bhi Karbal Ka Mujahid Hoon (x2) Bathanay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shahibay Kas Ka Utaya Na Kise Ney Lasha (x2)
Laash Har Ek Ke Shah Run Mein (x2) Utahnay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Zainab Ki Rida Cheen Kay Kehta Tah Shimaar (x2)
Aab Kaho Ghazi Se Parda Woh (x2) Bachanay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehti Thi Qaid Mein Banno Se Sakina Har Shab (x2)
Aaj Bhi Baba Na Seenay Mai (x2) Sulanay Aye.
<<DIVIDER>>
Shor-e-Nabhiyon Mein Utha Aho Fughan Ka Shahid (x2)
Shah-e-Deen Lash-e-akbar Jo (x2) Uthanay Aye.
